# BuzzBaazaar

> Pakistan’s viral street and content marketing partner for global brands. We make noise in all the right places.

BuzzBaazaar is a Karachi-based below-the-line (BTL) and viral marketing company. It combines remote creative production (short-form video, street content, sponsored social experiments, surveys, creator campaigns) with on-ground execution in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad (activations, sampling, ambassadors, field research, a branded rooftop-convertible fleet in Karachi). International brands are the primary audience; Pakistani brands are served at /pakistan/.

Facts: Headquarters Karachi, Pakistan. Phone/WhatsApp +92 343 3556817. Email hello@buzzbaazaar.com. Hours Monday to Saturday 10:00am to 7:00pm PKT. Prices are draft indicative 'from' prices in USD, confirmed on a strategy call. No client logos, case-study results or rankings are claimed.

## Solutions
- [Viral Content Engine](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/viral-content-engine/): Short-form street content, produced in Pakistan and delivered ready to post.
- [Creator and Influencer Campaigns](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/creator-campaigns/): The right Pakistani creators for your brief, managed end to end.
- [Sponsored Social Experiments and Shows](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/social-experiments/): Content people choose to watch, with your brand built in.
- [Surveys and Social Awareness Campaigns](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/surveys-awareness/): Run a survey your brand can own, publish and cite.
- [Elite Brand Ambassadors, Models and Actors](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/talent/): Polished on-camera and on-stage talent for premium moments.
- [Pakistan Market Entry and Testing](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/pakistan-market-entry/): Find out how Pakistan responds before you commit a full budget.
- [Field and BTL Activations](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/): Brand moments in public places, run end to end.
- [Rooftop Car Fleet](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/rooftop-car-fleet/): A branded convertible that stops the street, filmed from the first reveal.
- [Brand Ambassadors and Event Staff](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/brand-ambassadors/): Briefed, presentable teams for activations, expos and roadshows.
- [Proximity and Guerrilla Marketing](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/proximity-marketing/): Reach the customers already near you before your next sale.
- [Research and Insights](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/research-insights/): Real-world data from the streets and shelves of Pakistan.
- [Dedicated Offshore Pod](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/dedicated-pod/): A small team assigned to your brand, working as part of yours.
